content: Tyakekoterenae Xaiminisaka

Awa atyo inityohaliti hiwatyalihena hoka kinatyaxa hiraehena ekakoa. Hiraehena ekakoa hoka hexe kakoa hiraetere akereta hirae ekakoa. Nikare hiwatyalihena xoimahalitinae hoka haxenane, hiximarene kakoa hiraetere akereta hirae ekakoaha.
Inityohalotinae kakoa hiraehena hoka hityo kakoa hiraetere akereta hirae. Xoimahalotinae kakoa hiraehena hoka hahahalonae kakoa hiraetere akereta hirae, awa atyo iniyalahare hahekotya ekakoaha.
Wainiyaneneronae mahinaehalohalonae hoka hakahinaetyahene.

Xakore hoka wainiyaneneronaiya atyo kaisaniye, kajiyetexe hoka hatyonaiya atyo kahinaetene. Irihareya kahinaetyahitaha hanityo, hasero xoaha hoka ehekoreya. Nikareya hoka bakahenahitaha hanexenaeha, hanityonaeha, hatyokoenaeha aenaehenaherene katyahe. Enore atyo awaiyetita hatyoharenae.
Wainiyaneneroiya hawawahalo kaiserehare tyaonitere atyo, maisa xala hare kahinaetyare hoka Enore kahinaerene atyahita, hoka iraexaita ferakoa, makiya xoaha Enore kahinaetene maheta.
Xakore hoka wainiyaneneroiya hakéhalahalone maniya taita tyaona hoka ekamane atyo tyaonita, kaseta xakore hoka.
Timóteo, maika noxaotyakiri akereta hirae ihiyeha hoka waiyexe maniya taita tyaonaha hoka maisa xoare kaxawatyakita ehenoaha.
Hoka xala xamaniya maisa hahinaehare kahinaetita, exahe hanityo, hanexe hoka hatyo atyo matyakekoneta. Hatya matyakekonehare nawenane xahexe atyo tyaonita.
Maika wainiyaneneronae nexalo kaxomokakiterekoa 60 wanonexe xahexenae nexalo, exahe hakirore kaiyanenehenolo nexalo taita kaxomokaka.

Xoalini hare waiyexe ohiro nómane kawaiyakitere, haisaninae waiye aenaehenere, Enore koamaniya tyaoniterenae kiji tihitere, hatya kaokehena hoka hahanako waiye mokitere, haiyanae ana xoalini hare howitiharetere hiye kahinaetitere, exahe tyotya xoalini hare waiyexe taita tyomitalohalo nexalo taita atyoite kaxomokaka baberane koa.
Hoka awa atyo wainiyaneneronae xoimahalotitaterenae nexalo hamoka. Hiyaiya, haxahekola hiyetaiya kaiyanene aokowihena hoka halakisa Cristo koamaniya nawenatyaka.
Nikareya hoka maisa hetati iraetereha akereta tyomahitaha hoka maisaiya ehekoreta.
Exe tehitiya: Tyaonakoatyahitaha, tonakoatyahitaha hatinae nihatyaka, maisa xoare hekoti tyomareha. Iraesahitaha, haiyanae nawenane watyalyahitaha. Mairaetyakahare mahetare ene irai ahitaha.
Hiyeta hoka kasani xoimahaloti wainiyaneneronae kaiyaneneheta, kaisaniheta hoka kaxaiko haisaninae, exahe hahanaha hare naowita. Nikareya hoka wahalakoaharenae maisa iniyalahare iraetaha witahi.
Hiyaiya, koxaka haiyahalonae wainiyaneneronae halakisaha hatyakekoneha Cristo hoka Ahalakoahaliti koamaniya tyaonaha.

Maika hatya tyakekohatiye hinaehalo wainiyanenero hoka kahinaetene. Awa atyo tyotya tyakekohatiyenae kahinaetyahene aoka, waiya aliya hoka howitihare enomanaha. Hawawahalonae tyaoniterenae atyo ite tyakekohatiyenae kahinaehena.
Tyakekohatiyenae kaxaikotyase waiye hakiterenae atyo waiye kabakatyakita. Iraiti Waiyexe xakaiterenae, aotyakijiterenae terota atyo waiye kabakatyakita.
Hiyaiya, exakerexe atyo nexa Iraiti Waiyexe:

content.text: “Awa atyo bowi kanase xolatya, tyahakita trigo kase hoka”.

content: Nihitiya:
Awa atyo kairaeharetyakehena tyakekohatiyenae kaxaikotyase hoka kasemaxematyaka. Hoka hinama, hanamaiya atyo irae hoka katyakekotyaka.
Iniyalahare tyomehenerenae haotikatita hiwatyali hoka haiyanae tehitiya mairaha hoka maisa nikare tyomahita.

Enore, Jesus Cristo, anjonae waiyexenae haotita heko niraeta: maika tyotya xoalini hare hisomehena hoka exe xaotyakisatinae hityakeko. Tyotya halitinae, exahe tyakekohatiyenae kaxaikotyase, exahe hihinaeharetere hoka hakakoa hamokahene.
Awa atyo hikaholawaka hikahe hiyomokala kakoa hatya seri heno Enore hatene haka maheta. Awa atyo haiyaharenae tyomehena iniyalahare hoka hakahinaetene. Waiye hikaxaikoawi.
Awa atyo one taita hisera, vinhoxa tehitiya ininae hisera hoka hityako kawetere makaheheta. Hiyaiya, kahalikihena hihokakita.
Haiyanae iniyalahare tyomehena hoka kawaiyakita rota, iniyalahare exomokakaha nahitita. Hoka haiyanae nómane iniyalahare atyo maisa haxerore kawaiyakere.
Nikare tehitiya xoalini hare waiyexe kaomakehena hoka kawaiyakita rota. Exahe hoka haiyanae atyo komita maisa waiye kasemakita xakore hoka maisaiya aliyakere kaxateroakisakita.
